1.text: By those [angels] who extract with violence<sup foot_note="228156">1</sup>

footnotes.228156: - i.e., those who tear out the souls of those destined for Hell.

2.text: And [by] those who remove with ease<sup foot_note="228157">1</sup>

footnotes.228157: - i.e., those angels who ease out the souls of those destined for Paradise.

3.text: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming<sup foot_note="228158">1</sup>

4.text: And those who race each other in a race<sup foot_note="228159">1</sup>

footnotes.228159: - Racing to deliver the souls of the believers to Paradise.

5.text: And those who arrange [each] matter,<sup foot_note="228160">1</sup>

6.text: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

7.text: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

8.text: Hearts,<sup foot_note="228161">1</sup> that Day, will tremble,

footnotes.228161: - Those of the disbelievers who denied the Resurrection.

10.text: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

11.text: Even if we should be decayed bones?"<sup foot_note="228163">1</sup>

footnotes.228163: - The disbelievers say this in ridicule of the warning.

12.text: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."<sup foot_note="228164">1</sup>

footnotes.228164: - i.e., "If that were so, we would not be able to escape punishment."

13.text: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

14.text: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

15.text: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

16.text: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

17.text: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

18.text: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

19.text: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

20.text: And he showed him the greatest sign,<sup foot_note="228165">1</sup>

footnotes.228165: - i.e., the miracle of his staff becoming a great snake.

21.text: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

22.text: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].<sup foot_note="228166">1</sup>

footnotes.228166: - An alternative meaning is "running [from the snake]."

23.text: And he gathered [his people] and called out

24.text: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

25.text: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].<sup foot_note="228167">1</sup>.

footnotes.228167: - i.e., for Pharaoh's setting himself up as a deity and for his previous oppression of the people and denial of Moses.

26.text: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

27.text: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

28.text: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

29.text: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.<sup foot_note="228168">1</sup>

footnotes.228168: - i.e., created the day from within the surrounding darkness.

30.text: And after that He spread the earth.

31.text: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

32.text: And the mountains He set firmly

33.text: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

34.text: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity<sup foot_note="228169">1</sup> -

35.text: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

36.text: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

37.text: So as for he who transgressed

38.text: And preferred the life of the world,

39.text: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

40.text: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord<sup foot_note="228170">1</sup> and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

41.text: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

42.text: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?<sup foot_note="228171">1</sup>

43.text: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?<sup foot_note="228172">1</sup>

footnotes.228172: - Meaning that Muḥammad (ﷺ) had no knowledge of it, so how could he inform them?

44.text: To your Lord is its finality.<sup foot_note="228173">1</sup>

footnotes.228173: - i.e., its destination and termination. And to Him belongs ultimate knowledge of it.

45.text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

46.text: It will be, on the Day they see it,<sup foot_note="228174">1</sup> as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
